scientific_scope_status: For a>0 and independent exponential correct/wrong races at each correctly reached stage j, B_j=sum_(k=1)^j b_k gives F_L=product_(j=0)^(L-1) a/(a+B_j). The accumulated hazard exposure is S_L=sum_j B_j/a=sum_(k=1)^(L-1)(L-k)b_k/a. Power-law contact assumptions give the source O(L^2),O(L log L),O(L) exposure cases; these are not generic exact asymptotics for -log F_L outside small hazards. A separate active/trapped model has P_j=a/[a+d_A+j*b*(x+d_T)/(r_esc+x+d_T)]. With no irreversible terms and r_esc>0, every stage eventually succeeds but E[T_L]=L/a+b*L*(L-1)/(2*a*r_esc). Thus retained sites can cause time cost without necessarily causing wrong products.
